channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Iran, Oman, US ‘close’ to Hormuz deal: What do they all want?
item.description: An agreement could restore shipping through crucial waterway, paving way for peace talks between Tehran and Washington.

item.title: Lebanon and Israel still split over disarming Hezbollah at Rome talks
item.description: Disagreements remain in second day of resumed talks over disarming Hezbollah and Israeli withdrawal from South Lebanon.

item.title: India’s severe monsoon season causes more than 100 deaths since July
item.description: Monsoon downpours cause floods and landslides as climate change and El Nino disrupt rainfall patterns.

item.title: Russian attacks kill 17, exploiting Ukraine’s lack of missile interceptors
item.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy says Russian forces used 29 missiles and 115 drones during the assault.

item.title: Trump hails progress but warned Iran of ‘hard hit’ if no deal reached
item.description: US President Donald Trump says progress with Iran has been made, but warned Iran of 'hard hit' if no deal reached.

item.title: Japan tests US-Tomahawk missile as it moves away from Post-WWII status
item.description: Japan tested a US-Tomahawk cruise missile, launching from their Chokai warship in the Pacific Ocean on July 29.

item.title: Mexican influencer shot dead during livestream
item.description: César Gastélum, who was known for comedy and lifestyle posts, was killed at close range by a man on a motorbike.

item.title: Record heatwave in South Korea as temperatures soar to 42.5C
item.description: There have been at least 19 deaths related to the heatwave which has brought the country's hottest day since records began.

item.title: Trump says Iran will be 'hit very hard' if Hormuz Strait not open soon as oil prices fall
item.description: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio and Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent both announced talks had progressed to allow shipments to resume.

item.title: Mass funeral in Gaza for 112 Palestinians killed in 2023 Israeli strike
item.description: The bodies - belonging to members of two extended families - have only recently been recovered from under rubble in Gaza City.
